## Appendix A: sample pool appendix for make_study tests

Each entry shows the question and choices verbatim, then the correct answer with a one-line why.

> **E1A01** Which operator class conveys all available U.S. amateur operating privileges?
> A. Technician
> B. General
> C. Advanced
> D. Amateur Extra
> **Answer: D** — the Extra class conveys all available privileges — taught in chapter 1.

Published ID line: `E1A01 (D) [97.9(a)]`

> **E1A02** What is the maximum transmitting power an amateur station may use on 20 meters?
> A. 200 watts PEP
> B. 500 watts PEP
> C. 1500 watts PEP
> D. 5000 watts PEP
> **Answer: C** — the legal limit is 1500 W PEP — taught in chapter 1.

Published ID line: `E1A02 (C) [97.313]`

> **E1B01** When must an amateur station transmit its call sign?
> A. Every 5 minutes during a contact
> B. At least every 10 minutes during and at the end of a contact
> C. Once per hour while operating
> D. Only at the beginning of a contact
> **Answer: B** — identification is required every ten minutes and at sign-off — taught in chapter 1.

Published ID line: `E1B01 (B) [97.119(a)]`

> **E2A01** What is an amateur satellite?
> A. A station in space operating in the amateur-satellite service
> B. A radio that only receives weather broadcasts
> C. An antenna with more than one element
> D. A type of battery charger
> **Answer: A** — a satellite is a space station of the amateur-satellite service — taught in chapter 2.

Published ID line: `E2A01 (A)`

> **E5A01** What is the unit of electrical current?
> A. Volt
> B. Ampere
> C. Ohm
> D. Watt
> **Answer: B** — current is measured in amperes — taught in chapter 5.

Published ID line: `E5A01 (B)`

> **E9G06** On the Smith chart shown in Figure E9-3, what is the impedance at the center of the chart?
> A. 50 + j0 ohms
> B. 0 + j0 ohms
> C. 75 + j50 ohms
> D. Infinite impedance
> **Answer: A** — the center of a Smith chart is the normalized impedance 1 + j0, 50 + j0 ohms in a 50-ohm system — taught in chapter 9.

Published ID line: `E9G06 (A)`
